extraMeanings.en: a document or proposal that is formally sent for consideration
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The deadline for the submission of your application is Friday.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Başvurunuzun teslim tarihi cumadır.

extraMeanings.en: the most important or main part of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The substance of his argument was that we need more funding.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Argümanının özü daha fazla fona ihtiyacımız olduğuydu.

extraMeanings.en: to be very bad or unpleasant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This weather really sucks; it's been raining all week.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu hava gerçekten berbat; bütün hafta yağmur yağıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to move forward quickly and suddenly in a large group
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The crowd surged toward the stage when the singer appeared.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcı göründüğünde kalabalık sahneye doğru akın etti.

extraMeanings.en: to give up something or hand it over, often officially
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He had to surrender his passport to the police.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Pasaportunu polise teslim etmek zorunda kaldı.

extraMeanings.en: to hang something from above
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tavandan bir lamba asılmıştı.

extraMeanings.en: to officially prevent someone from doing their job or attending for a period
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The student was suspended from school for a week.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğrenci bir haftalığına okuldan uzaklaştırıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to influence someone's opinion or decision
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Nothing you say will sway her decision.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Söyleyeceğin hiçbir şey onun kararını değiştirmeyecek.

extraMeanings.en: to spread quickly across an area
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A wave of panic swept through the city.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehri bir panik dalgası kapladı.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden or big change in opinion, mood, or amount
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a big swing in public opinion before the election.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Seçimden önce kamuoyunda büyük bir görüş değişimi oldu.

extraMeanings.en: to follow someone secretly to watch what they do
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The detective tailed the suspect for hours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dedektif şüpheliyi saatlerce takip etti.

extraMeanings.en: to attach a label to something or mark someone in a post
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She tagged me in the photo she posted online.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İnternette paylaştığı fotoğrafta beni etiketledi.

extraMeanings.en: (of food, especially meat) easy to cut or chew, not tough
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The steak was so tender it melted in my mouth.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Biftek o kadar yumuşaktı ki ağzımda dağıldı.

extraMeanings.en: (of a part of the body) painful when touched
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My ankle is still tender after the fall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Düşmeden sonra bileğim hâlâ acıyor.

extraMeanings.tr: sıra ev, bitişik nizam evler dizisi
extraMeanings.en: a row of houses joined together
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They live in a small house in a Victorian terrace.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Viktorya dönemi sıra evlerinde küçük bir evde yaşıyorlar.

extraMeanings.en: the way food feels in the mouth
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cake had a light, fluffy texture.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kekin hafif, kabarık bir kıvamı vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to pass thread or something long through a narrow space
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She threaded the needle carefully.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İğneye dikkatlice iplik geçirdi.

extraMeanings.en: a connected series of ideas or a storyline running through something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I lost the thread of the conversation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Konuşmanın gidişatını kaybettim.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel very excited and pleased
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It thrilled her to see her name in the newspaper.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Adını gazetede görmek onu çok heyecanlandırdı.

extraMeanings.en: a strong desire for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She has a real thirst for knowledge.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gerçek bir bilgi açlığı var onda.
